title: All-metadata item page: the disabled Save gives 'No changes to save' only as a title on a disabled button, so keyboard and assistive-technology users never get it
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · acceptance[1]

Found by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`). Same class as #31495 (Studio Publish), which now passes.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. Open `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/view/showcase_task.done`. It is an overlay view, so the page reads "Writable".
2. `[data-testid=resource-save]` is natively disabled, with `title` and `aria-label` both "No changes to save".
3. Hover shows no `[role=tooltip]`. Tab never reaches the button. The aria-label replaces the button's accessible name "Save" with the reason.

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

**Expected:** the treatment #31495 gave Publish: a focusable wrapper with a tooltip, aria-describedby pointing at the reason, and the button keeping its own name.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, around line 2958: the Save Button has `disabled={saving || (!createMode && !isDirty) || …}`, with `aria-label={saveTitle}` and `title={saveTitle}`.

Owning package: `@object-ui/app-shell`.
